_comment: JoyPro's function knowledge map (engine/EngineFunctionMap.cs, docs/relation-builder.md 'Function map'). One entry per common flight, space and vehicle function: id, name, category, kind (axis / button / both: what the function usually is), only (axis / button: no other action can be it), synonyms (English, matched as whole words in an action's title, plural 's' ignored), terms (game ids, 'DCS' or 'class:heli' / 'class:space': words that mean the function only there), not (words that rule the function out when they are in the title outside the matched words), dirs (direction words; given = only these count), sided (axes per engine or wheel: left / right), axisDirs (axes take a direction from dirs), keyed (number / label: the action's own key, PTT 1, UFC 7), slots (DB/Functions slots.json: catalog slot -> direction[@weight]), related (functions a search also lists, ranked lower), priority (breaks ties between functions that match equally long words). Directions: up down left right fwd aft in out increase decrease on off toggle open close extend retract next prev cw ccw press hold reset arm safe and the functions' own ones.

yaw: turn left right with the pedals
trim_pitch: hold the nose without pushing the stick
trim_set: trim to where the stick is
parking_brake: hold the aircraft on the ground
reverse_thrust: slow down after landing with the engines
laser: mark the target with the laser
tms: lock the target with the hat
make a sensor point of interest
pitot_heat: keep the speed sensor free of ice
wing_fold: fold the wings on the carrier
drag_chute: parachute to slow down after landing
lights_anticollision: strobe lights so others see you
view_padlock: follow the enemy with the eyes

functions.name: Throttle
functions.desc: Engine power lever, also the helicopter collective and the spaceship forward/backward thrust.

functions.name: Helicopter engine throttle / power lever
functions.desc: The engine throttle or power control levers of a helicopter (twist grip, EEG levers), not the collective.
